kayla_cs: Quick heads-up  EU Dedicated onboarding experienced intermittent 502s and higher tail latency from 09:4009:55 UTC. Affected trial/onboard flows for four tenants: T-9901, T-9905, T-9912, T-9920. Preparing customer status notes + remediation offers.

omar_support: Saw the spike at 09:41, kicked failover to standby pool at 09:46; errors dropped ~70% but a few customers still saw retries. Collected request samples and oauth logs.

jess_eng: Short summary: batching scheduler hit an edge under multipart ingest; triggered workers to restart repeatedly. Applied temporary concurrency cap (max_batches=4) and restarted workers at 09:50. Hotfix in review, ETA ~3h.

kayla_cs: Draft outbound below  please approve tone and credit wording.

kayla_cs: ```Hi <CustomerTeam>,

Were reaching out about a transient issue in our EU Dedicated onboarding pipeline on Mar 25 between 09:4009:55 UTC. During that window some onboarding calls experienced increased latency and intermittent 502 responses which may have delayed completion.

What we did: activated regional failover when needed, restarted affected workers, and applied temporary batching caps to stabilize throughput.

How we can help: we can re-run any stalled onboarding batches for you, schedule a 30-minute remediation workshop with an integration engineer, and apply a one-time credit to offset retry-related compute.

Self-help: to reduce retries you can set batch_size=4 and add a small retry_backoff (~250ms). If you require strict EU-only handling, reply and we will not enable cross-region routing without explicit approval.

We will publish a technical RCA within 48 hours after verification of the fix.

Thanks,
Kayla on behalf of Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

marco_billing: Legal approved credit language: "A one-time credit equivalent to estimated compute used during the impacted window will be applied to your next invoice."

omar_support: I'll create remediation office-hours invites (Mon/Tue 15:00-17:00 UTC) and attach a diagnostics checklist.

jess_eng: Agreed on draft. Adding note to RCA that we're adding a regression test to CI to catch this request shape.

incident_bot: Incident logged: 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-Transient (P2). Lead: jess_eng.

kayla_cs: Sending localized EN/FR copies now and tagging renewals for T-9920 as high-touch for follow-up. Will paste sent copy and recipients here once sent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
